_comment:
Instantly campaign definition for the OryonIQ reach-engine pilot. Created via POST /api/v2/campaigns, saved here for reference/reproducibility; creation does NOT activate (campaigns start in draft). {{personalization}} is filled per-lead from the engine's opener via push_to_instantly.py; {{sendrPageUrl}} is the lead's own Sendr page, supplied per-lead as a top-level custom_variable (leads without a page are skipped rather than enrolled, so today it is never empty in practice — but no follow-up step depends on it, so a future change to that skip rule cannot break a sentence). RESTRUCTURED 2026-08-21 from a single send into a 4-step sequence: a single-touch cold campaign leaves the replies that normally arrive on touches 2–4 on the table. STRUCTURE: step 1 = day 0, TWO A/B variants (Instantly rotates them); step 2 = +3 days; step 3 = +4 days; step 4 = +6 days — i.e. touches land roughly on day 0 / 3 / 7 / 13, widening gaps so the later touches read as patient rather than persistent, and each lands on a different weekday instead of always hitting the same slot. `delay` is read here as 'days to wait before sending THIS step, counted from the previous one' (step 1 = 0 = send on enrolment); the schedule window still gates actual dispatch, so a delay that lands on a weekend goes out the next business morning. CONFIRM that reading in the Instantly UI after import before activating. STEP 1 VARIANT A IS THE EXISTING, UNDER-REVIEW BODY — unchanged, byte for byte. VARIANT B is a new angle that stays strictly inside reach-engine/oryoniq-product-features.md (award data / who is teaming with whom / connection mapping into decision-makers); it makes no pre-RFP, NAICS-filter or SDB-matching claim. ⚠️ STEPS 2, 3 AND 4 ARE NOT FINISHED COPY. Their structure, length and tone are done; their persuasive content is a [[!! ... !!]] placeholder block, because the two claims the current copy leans on are both disputed and awaiting the boss's decision: (a) 'federal set-asides are opening fast' does not follow from the CMMC Phase II suspension and is simply wrong, and (b) 'flags the pursuits that fit your NAICS and SDB status before the RFP drops' describes a capability that appears nowhere on oryoniq.com (see oryoniq-product-features.md, 'Open question'). Neither claim is repeated in any new step. OPERATOR FILL-IN CHECKLIST before this campaign may send: (1) replace every [[!! ... !!]] block in steps 2–4 — there are four, one in step 2, one in step 3, two in step 4; (2) strip the '[[DRAFT — DO NOT SEND]]' prefix from the step 2–4 subject lines, or blank those subjects entirely if you want the follow-ups to thread under the step 1 email, which is the usual choice; (3) decide the step 1 A/B question only after enough volume to mean anything, and remember the config's `signal`/`offer` still carry claim (a)/(b) into {{personalization}} and into the Sendr page, so fixing this file alone does not fix the campaign. DEPLOYMENT IS A HUMAN STEP: ⚠️ PATCH /campaigns/{id} with a `sequences` body REACTIVATES a paused campaign (verified 2026-08-21) — whoever deploys must GET the campaign's status straight afterwards and POST /campaigns/{id}/pause if it moved. Body markup keeps the
-per-paragraph convention on purpose: multi-merge-tag templates built from bare
tags get silently stripped of all plain text by Instantly.

variants.subject: [[DRAFT - DO NOT SEND]] one specific thing for {{companyName}}
variants.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Rather than restate the pitch, here is the specific version for {{companyName}}:

[[!! PLACEHOLDER - TOUCH 2 / PROOF POINT. NOT SENDABLE COPY. Replace this entire bracketed block with ONE concrete, checkable observation from the prospect's own competitive landscape - for example a recent award in their segment and the prime/sub pairing behind it, or a supplier relationship they would not have seen. It must be something OryonIQ genuinely produces per oryoniq-product-features.md (award data, teaming pairs, prime supplier lists, connection mapping). It must NOT claim pre-RFP alerting, NAICS filtering, SDB matching, or that federal set-asides are opening - both of those claims are disputed and pending the boss's decision. Keep it to two sentences. !!]]

If that is the kind of input you would want in front of you before a bid/no-bid call, I can show you where it comes from.

Ellen
OryonIQ, VisioneerIT

variants.subject: [[DRAFT - DO NOT SEND]] the part I left out
variants.body:

Ellen

variants.body:

Ellen
